visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with curly brown hair, wearing a pearl necklace, a black-and-white checkered dress, and a white cardigan, enters a room through a wooden door. A man with short brown hair, wearing a brown vest over a patterned shirt, stands with his back to the camera near a wooden cabinet holding a metal thermos. (2) Close-up shots alternate between the woman's face, featuring red lipstick and expressive eyes, and the man's face. The man has a small black tattoo on the right side of his neck and large white earrings. (3) The man speaks animatedly, gesturing with his hands. They are in a room with a purple sofa, yellow cushions, and a tall black speaker in the background. (4) The woman crosses her arms and looks away with a skeptical expression. The man continues talking, looking directly at her while standing in the middle of the room. (5) The man raises his right hand in a fist, emphasizing a point. The woman reacts with a look of shock and alarm, leaning back away from him. (6) Both characters are barefoot on a wooden floor, jumping over two horizontal bamboo poles that are being tapped together by off-screen hands. The man wears a brown skirt-like garment. The woman trips and falls onto her side. (7) The woman is on her hands and knees on the floor, looking upwards with a fierce, angry expression. The scene cuts to both of them now wearing white t-shirts with pink and yellow logos. (8) A digital product overlay appears on the left with a QR code and a price of 790 Yuan for a T-shirt. The man rolls up his sleeve to show a large green dragon tattoo on his forearm. (9) The man holds up a small playing card featuring a portrait of the woman. The woman smiles and playfully touches the man's arm while wearing her white cardigan over the t-shirt. (10) A fan of various playing cards is displayed toward the camera with a 350 Yuan price overlay. The man then uses a green and yellow patterned towel to wipe the woman's face; a 500 Yuan price overlay appears. (11) The woman holds a bright green smartphone to her ear, smiling widely as she speaks. The man stands beside her, looking at her before the video ends with a red title card on a white background.
